### Latest Release, ENJOY!!

**Cracked by** [@Spy_G](https://t.me/spyg_vault)

> [!NOTE]
> - 🔑 No subscription required. 
> - ✅ New Downloads manager.
> - 📺 Full 4KHDR support.
> - 📝 [6.0 release notes](https://github.com/dayanch96/YTLite/releases/tag/v6.0)
> - 🫧  Liquid Glass and iPhone Duo support.
> - 🆕 `YTLowContrastMode` tweak, enabled by default.
>
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks: 
> - `YouPip` `YTweaks` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality` `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare`  `YTLowContrastMode` 
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `VolumeBoostYT`

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
> - ⚠Fix downloads by setting downloading button placement in youtubeplus settings to Overlay.
> - ⚠Disable Liquid Glass option in Interface settings if tab bar is glitched for you. or reinstall on top of the installed ipa.  Video player bar is still glitched.
